caption: The drawing depicts a single chest or trunk with a domed lid, rendered in shades of beige and light brown. The chest features a pronounced horizontal wooden or wooden-colored strip running along the edge where the lid meets the base. Numerous round metallic rivets or studs accent the edges and corners of the chest, arranged in straight lines and following the contours of the trunk, including the top, sides, and base. There is a metallic handle attached to the middle of the lid and a metallic latch and lock mechanism at the front center of the chest. The background is plain and off-white, and there is a small, handwritten inscription in brown ink at the lower right corner with the text: "MABEL G. CLAFLIN - TAOS - N.M."
title: Leather Covered Box
